title: The obstacle is the way
idea: What blocks your path can become your path. A setback gives you something to work with.
apply: When blocked, ask what this obstacle makes possible, then take the first small step through it.
remind: Use the obstacle. It is the path.
who: Kai, a freelance developer who just lost his biggest client.

scenes.cap: of Kai's income, gone in one email
scenes.nar: Kai is a freelance developer. One email arrives, and his biggest client, sixty percent of his income, is gone.

msgs.x: Two days of complaining. No new work.

scenes.nar: His first reaction is that this ruins everything. He spends two days stuck in complaint, and no new work arrives.

items: A reason to raise my rates

scenes.nar: Then he turns it around. The obstacle is also the material. It frees up time, gives him a reason to raise his rates, and pushes him to spread his risk.
Three months later he has several clients, none above thirty percent of his income, at higher rates. The setback became the route.
